ai.consent.kept: Neither this service nor the AI provider keeps the conversation; the app holds it in memory only while you use it, never on the device, in a backup or in a result.
ai.consent.never: Your name, birth data, earlier results and notes are never sent. Please do not type your name or contact details in the conversation.
ai.consent.photo.change: Once it is on, the promise that everything you enter stays on this device no longer holds for the photos you choose to send:
ai.consent.photo.kept: Neither this service nor the AI provider keeps the photo, and the app never saves it: it is held in memory while the screen is open and dropped when you leave — not on the device, in a backup or in a result.
ai.consent.photo.never: No name, birth data, earlier results or notes are sent with it. Please keep other people, documents and screens out of the picture.
ai.consent.photo.sent: A photo you choose is shrunk on your device, stripped of place, time and camera details, and sent once — when you press Send — to this service and to the AI provider we name, to suggest which of the app's own tongue or face features it shows. You confirm each suggestion yourself.
ai.consent.photo.unproven: This is a development feature. Its suggestions have not been checked against practitioners' readings; they count only after you confirm them, at the quality of your own observation.
ai.consent.sent: What you type in the conversation is sent, only while you use it, to this service and to the AI provider we name, to pick out symptoms that you then confirm one by one.
ai.consent.title: Turn on AI help?
ai.consent.tongue.title: Turn on photo help for your tongue?
ai.consent.withdraw: You can turn it off at any time in Settings; the questions without AI give the same result.

ai.photo.face.card.body: A photo of your face suggests your complexion and your lips for you to confirm.
ai.photo.face.guide.avoid: No make-up, filters or beauty modes, and nobody else in the frame. After exercise, a hot drink or a hot shower, rest a few minutes first.
ai.photo.face.guide.light: Take it in daylight by a window, facing the light; avoid coloured lamps and strong shadows.
ai.photo.face.guide.pose: Face the camera, relaxed, eyes open, hair off your forehead, glasses off. Hold the phone at arm's length with your face filling most of the frame.
ai.photo.face.status.none: Nothing noted from a photo yet.

ai.photo.guide.title: How to take it
ai.photo.notice: AI help is on: a photo you send is shrunk on your device, stripped of place and time, sent once to this service and the AI provider, and not kept. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
ai.photo.preview.hint: If it looks right, send it. Nothing has left your device yet.
ai.photo.preview.label: Your photo. It is shown only on this screen.
ai.photo.preview.title: Look at your photo
ai.photo.quality.blurry: It is out of focus: hold the phone steady, tap the screen on your tongue or face to focus, and try again.
ai.photo.quality.bright: It is too bright, or the light glares: move out of direct sun and strong lamps.
ai.photo.quality.cast: The light has coloured the picture: use daylight, and switch off any filter.
ai.photo.quality.dark: It is too dark: turn towards a window or a lamp.
ai.photo.quality.flat: There is hardly any detail: is the lens covered, or is the frame filled with something plain?
ai.photo.quality.small: The picture is too small: use the camera's normal setting.
ai.photo.quality.title: This photo will not do yet
ai.photo.result.intro: Look at the photo and at yourself. Confirm only what you can see: each suggestion counts only after you confirm it, and then as your own observation.
ai.photo.result.none: Nothing from the app's list stood out clearly in this photo.
ai.photo.result.pending: Answer each suggestion first, then you can finish.
ai.photo.result.title: What the assistant thinks it sees
ai.photo.tongue.guide.avoid: Wait after eating, drinking coffee or tea, foods or medicines that stain, or scraping the tongue coating. No filters or beauty modes.
ai.photo.tongue.guide.light: Take it in daylight by a window, facing the light; avoid coloured lamps.
ai.photo.tongue.guide.pose: Open your mouth and stick your tongue out gently, relaxed, for a few seconds. Hold the phone upright with the tongue in the middle of the frame, filling about a third of it.
ai.photo.tongue.title: Tongue photo (AI help)
ai.photo.unreadable: The assistant could not read this photo (light, focus or framing). Try another, or use the usual steps.
